messages.author: bac5bf5bc53cbb65
messages.subject: Factor Scores
parts:
Greetings,

I was wondering if there is any plan to enable output of factor scores for latent variables in userGWAS? I am calculating a PRS and would like to do cross-validation, so I need that phenotype.
I see that in your 2019 paper the PRS was specified to predict latent variables in the context of a confirmatory model, so perhaps there is a reason why factor scores should not be pulled out and used in regression outside of a factor model?

Thanks!
Katerina

messages.author: ac421cf36d1a4c37
messages.subject: Re: Factor Scores
parts:
Hi Katerina,

All modelling in Genomic SEM is performed on summary statistics. You would need individual level data to estimate factor scores. You can of course extract factor score estimates based on a standard (non Genomic) SEM of phenotypes in a prediction cohort, and then use those in conjunction with a PRS. In what you are referring to, we did the PRS prediction analyses in the standard SEM itself, rather than first computing factor scores.

That said, perhaps you mean that you would like to compute a PRS for a common genetic factor, as estimated in Genomic SEM? To do that, you produce summary statistics for that factor using userGWAS or commonfactorGWAS (perhaps first pruning out Q loci), and then compute the PRS for your prediction cohort using those new sumstats.

The new externalizing paper in Nature Neuroscience also has some nice examples of how to do both of the above. https://externalizing.org/publications/ You may need to download the preprint if it's not up at the journal yet.

All the best,

Elliot
